clue.text: Conservative's honourable victory before midnight

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', joining the definition to the wordplay

parts.note: a Right Honourable is the title of a senior British politician, so honourable suggests right
a victory is a win
the middle of the word night is its letter G

explanation.surface: A Tory claims an honest win just before the clock strikes twelve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'midnight' is a crossword convention: the middle of 'night' is G. 'before' just puts the pieces in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Conservative politics sit on the right of the political spectrum.

clue.text: Lightning attack, absorbing pressure

indicators.note: absorbing means the attack word takes the pressure letter into its middle

parts.note: a raid is an attack
P is the physics abbreviation for pressure

explanation.surface: A blitz goes in under heavy pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: Lightning as an adjective describes something extremely fast, a synonym of swift.

clue.text: A former German official might, it is said, travel relatively unencumbered

indicators.note: it is said tells the solver the words are to be spoken and heard, not spelt

parts.note: to travel unencumbered is to go light, so relatively more so is to go lighter

explanation.surface: A Nazi functionary is rumoured to pack light for his journeys.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go lighter', spoken, matches the German title; 'might' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: A Gauleiter was a Nazi party district leader in Hitler's Germany.

clue.text: Kind words (in print)

parts.note: a kind is a type
script is written words, as in the words of a play

explanation.surface: Printed matter offers gentle sentiments.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines the answer as well: typed or printed words are typescript.
explanation.definitionFit: Typescript is text produced on a typewriter, which looks like print.

clue.text: One about to come down to the country

parts.note: the Roman numeral I stands for one
re means about or concerning
to land is to come down to the ground

explanation.surface: Someone is about to fly down to the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Ireland is a nation, the Republic in the west of the British Isles.

clue.text: Shot a number of supporters with beards

parts.note: a shot is a go, an attempt
golf tees support the ball, so several of them are tees

explanation.surface: Gunmen fired at a crowd of bearded fans.
explanation.definitionFit: Goatees are small pointed beards on the chin.

clue.text: Phoney about-turn in public transport

indicators.note: in means the reversed turn word sits inside the transport word

parts.note: a bus is public transport

indicators.note: about signals that the word for a turn is read backwards

parts.note: a turn is a go, as in 'your go'

explanation.surface: A fraudster performs a sudden U-turn on the bus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about-turn' looks like a single phrase meaning a U-turn, but 'about' is the reversal signal and 'turn' is a go.
explanation.definitionFit: Phoney and bogus are synonyms for fake or fraudulent.

clue.text: Hard knock for a follower with depression

parts.note: B follows A in the alphabet
a low is a weather depression

explanation.surface: Getting depressed is a hard knock for a hanger-on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a follower' means the letter that follows A: B.
explanation.definitionFit: A blow is a hit or a setback, a hard knock.

clue.text: Good party — but sober!

parts.note: a rave is a lively party

explanation.surface: A great party, yet everyone stayed sober.
explanation.definitionFit: Grave and sober both mean serious and solemn.

clue.text: Same motor cycle? Get it cleaned here

indicators.note: to cycle letters is to put them through a round of rearrangement

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether the same motorbike can be washed at this garage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cycle' looks like a motorbike but rearranges SAME MOTOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A steam room is a heated bathing room where you sweat yourself clean.

clue.text: Victoria perhaps needs quiet to make a choice

parts.note: the Victoria is a variety of plum
p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: Queen Victoria needs silence before deciding.
explanation.walkthrough: Victoria is a British plum variety, not the queen.
explanation.definitionFit: To plump for something is to choose it decisively.

clue.text: Complex work in America accepted by consumer mostly!

indicators.note: accepted by means the American work word is taken inside the shortened consumer word
mostly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: an eater is a consumer
labor is the American spelling of labour, work

explanation.surface: Consumers mostly took on complex jobs in the States.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' cuts EATER to EATE, which takes in LABOR.
explanation.definitionFit: Elaborate means intricate and detailed, much as complex does.

clue.text: Neptune is on his throne

parts.note: the sea god, sitting on his throne at the bottom of the ocean, is literally seated in the deep

explanation.surface: The Roman sea god is sitting in state.
explanation.definitionFit: Firmly established, as a long-held feeling is deep-rooted.

clue.text: About to get morning paper

parts.note: re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Someone is about to fetch the morning newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: A ream is a quantity of paper, 500 sheets.

clue.text: Well, bread is an oriental sort of food

parts.note: a spring is a well, a natural source of water
a roll is a small loaf of bread

explanation.surface: Bread is a kind of food in the East as well.
explanation.definitionFit: A spring roll is a fried pancake roll from Chinese cuisine.

clue.text: Newspaper boss, on topless spread, said…

indicators.note: in an across clue on means the boss comes after the spread
topless means the first letter is removed

parts.note: butter is a spread
ED is short for editor

explanation.surface: An editor runs a racy topless spread, then speaks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topless spread' sounds like a racy newspaper page, but it is a food spread with its first letter dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: Uttered means spoke aloud, a synonym of said.

clue.text: Out of bed, the scenery is disturbing

parts.note: someone out of bed is up
a setting is the scenery on a stage

explanation.surface: Getting out of bed, someone finds the view distressing.
explanation.definitionFit: Upsetting means distressing or troubling.

clue.text: … more unsettled by drink-"the chief…

parts.note: to sup is to drink

indicators.note: unsettled tells us the word more is jumbled

explanation.surface: A continuing sentence: more disturbed by drink, the boss.
explanation.walkthrough: Clues 14-17 across run on as one sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: A supremo is a person in overall charge, a boss.

clue.text: People who use a pen, or arrange…

indicators.note: arrange means the preceding letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Writers with a pen are asked to organise things.
explanation.definitionFit: Europeans are the inhabitants of Europe, a group of people.

clue.text: … step, sir, is to get organised with promotional insignia"

indicators.note: to get organised tells the solver the letters must be put in order

explanation.surface: Rank badges are earned by marching smartly, sir.
explanation.definitionFit: Stripes on a sleeve show military rank, gained by promotion.

clue.text: … last of essays to be summarised and marked

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of the word essays

parts.note: a potted history is a summarised one

explanation.surface: The last essays are summed up and graded.
explanation.definitionFit: Spotted means marked with spots or blemishes.

clue.text: Saying of glutton riding horse back

indicators.note: riding means the glutton word sits inside the horse word
back means the horse word is read in reverse

parts.note: a mare is a female horse
a pig is a glutton

explanation.surface: A remark about a greedy rider on horseback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horseback' reads as riding on a horse; split it, and 'back' turns the horse word round.
explanation.definitionFit: An epigram is a pithy, witty saying.

clue.text: Reaches out -if an old flame cares

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
to tend is to care for

explanation.surface: Someone makes contact to see if a former lover still cares.
explanation.definitionFit: Extends means stretches out, a synonym of reaches out.

clue.text: Volume that backs up in the motorway

indicators.note: backs up says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A big book causes a tailback on the motorway.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition took in 'that', which is only a link to the wordplay; the definition is 'Volume' alone. 'in' signals the hidden letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A tome is a large book, one volume.

clue.text: Island whisky with a chaser

parts.note: malt is malt whisky

explanation.surface: A whisky is ordered with a beer chaser on holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with a chaser' means A follows MALT.
explanation.definitionFit: Malta is a Mediterranean island nation.

clue.text: Somehow got at recipe, losing right for this dish

indicators.note: somehow means the letters are put together in some new way
losing means a letter is taken out

explanation.surface: Someone got hold of a recipe but lost the right to make the dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing' drops R from GOT AT RECIPE; 'Somehow' rearranges the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Cottage pie is a British dish of minced beef topped with mashed potato.

clue.text: Relieved when sunk in rising river

indicators.note: sunk in means the when word goes inside the river
rising in a down clue means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain
as means when

explanation.surface: People felt relief when the swollen river went down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns DEE into EED; AS sinks into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Eased means relieved of pain or pressure.

clue.text: Common sense denial facing American

parts.note: no is a denial

explanation.surface: Commonsense refusal confronting an American.
explanation.walkthrough: NOUS is British slang for practical good sense; 'facing' just orders the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Nous means practical intelligence, gumption.

clue.text: Complaint received in America illegally?

definitions.note: the definition is an adverb with a query; the answer is the adjective for things obtained illegally

parts.note: an illness is a complaint, so ill
gotten is the American past participle of get, received

explanation.surface: A complaint was registered in the States unlawfully.
explanation.definitionFit: Ill-gotten goods are obtained dishonestly or by crime.

clue.text: The Stones have no friends

parts.note: O is zero, nothing, so no
pals are friends

explanation.surface: The Rolling Stones are friendless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Stones' suggests the rock band, but means gems.
explanation.definitionFit: Opals are precious gemstones.

clue.text: Dope found in couch, perhaps

definitions.meaning: couch is a weedy kind of ...

explanation.surface: Drugs turned up down the back of the sofa.
explanation.definitionFit: Grass is slang for cannabis, and couch is a species of grass.

clue.text: Germany has shut down, it is revealed

parts.note: D is the international vehicle code for Germany
to shut down is to close

explanation.surface: News breaks that Germany has closed its borders.
explanation.definitionFit: Disclosed means made known, laid open.
